description: Holly Snowman default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/holly_snowman-character-sheet.png: the palette chips (intake.json swatches snow base 192,210,253 / snow shadow 133,167,252 / leaf green 16,47,29 / berry red 178,37,38 / eye 34,36,40 inferred by spacing / snow highlight 227,240,254) cross-checked against the drawn surfaces (service venv PIL, median of a box per surface; front-view boxes x0,y0,x1,y1 in each note). The sheet draws NO glow: no region emits.

snow.note: the one snow region (the graded shell's base tone): chip 192,210,253; drawn head top (235,275,265,300) median 185,206,253, head side (170,320,200,345) 183,204,253, feet (170,725,210,745) 183,203,252

snow_hi.note: GRADIENT TONE (v1.1: blended per vertex onto the snow by up-facing weight, no faces carry it) -- snow highlight on the upper lit areas: chip 227,240,254; drawn head top-left (185,295,200,305) 211,224,253, foot top (330,718,345,728) 206,220,253

snow_shade.note: GRADIENT TONE (blended per vertex by down-facing weight) -- snow shadow under the head / belly / feet: chip 133,167,252; drawn lower belly (230,680,270,700) median 143,175,252, under-head min 125,153,226

blush.note: GRADIENT TONE (a feathered per-vertex glow on the lower face) -- soft blue blush round / below the eyes: drawn face centre (240,395,260,415) median 144,176,252 -- NOT a chip (it sits between the base and the shadow chip)

eye.note: simple black oval eyes: chip 34,36,40 (inferred by spacing in the intake); drawn eye blobs x 216-227 / 274-285, y 336-369 (sum < 250)

leaf.note: leaf green, the darker half of every leaf: chip 16,47,29; drawn ear outer halves (335,230,360,260) / (140,230,165,260) median 14,42,29

leaf_light.note: the lighter half of every leaf (the rim side of the midrib): drawn ear inner halves (300,240,320,265) 21,57,38 / (180,240,200,265) 21,59,37; side ear front half (1030,235,1050,260) 20,53,33 -- NOT a chip

leaf_rim.note: the light green leaf rim: drawn ear rim pixels (G > 110, G > B + 20, G > R + 10 in the ear box 125-375 x 165-300) median 144,163,110; arm-leaf rims (300-470 x 440-520) 124,148,97 -- NOT a chip

berry.note: berry red (berry clusters + the three buttons): chip 178,37,38; drawn berry (426,537,434,545) median 171,35,39, button (246,478,254,486) 168,32,37

berry_hi.note: the white-ish highlight dot on each berry / button: drawn brightest berry pixels (sum > 500 in 400-465 x 515-595) median 251,179,170 -- NOT a chip
